findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_mentions, list_mention_comments, update_mention, add_keyword, update_keyword, list_feeds, add_feeds, update_feed, get_analytics_summary, get_analytics_breakdown, get_reviews_report, list_channels, list_attention, get_keyword_health, list_members, get_usage_breakdown, list_ledger, get_filters, list_people, get_person, list_activities, log_activity · Private data: list_keywords, whoami, get_usage, list_activities, log_activity · Public sink: search_mentions, list_mention_comments, add_keyword, add_feeds, get_analytics_summary, get_analytics_breakdown, get_share_of_voice, list_channels, list_attention, create_alert, mute_authors, get_keyword_health, delete_keyword, list_members, list_ledger, get_filters, list_people, get_person, list_activities, log_activity · Destructive: delete_segment, delete_view, delete_group, delete_feed, delete_alert, delete_keyword, get_usage, delete_activity.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
